profiles.name: Fats Pichon
profiles.excerpt: Fats Pichon was a New Orleans jazz pianist, singer and bandleader who became the resident pianist and a continuing character on Duffy’s Tavern.
profiles.bio_html:
Walter “Fats” Pichon was born in New Orleans in 1906 and built a professional career as a jazz pianist, singer and bandleader. His work carried him from New Orleans clubs and riverboats into national broadcasting.

After Eddie Green’s death, Pichon joined Duffy’s Tavern as the tavern pianist and a continuing on-air character. Scripts identify “Fats” at the piano, making music the foundation of the role even when he joined the comedy dialogue.

Golden Radio Hour currently preserves 13 Duffy’s Tavern performances credited to Pichon. Those broadcasts belong primarily with instrumentalists and singers while retaining acting as a secondary facet.
